summary: Convert a filesystem path to an absolute file: URL with Node escaping rules.

semantics.escaping: URL control characters such as # and % are percent-encoded as path data

caveats: Constructing new URL(path, 'file:') is not equivalent.
Relative path handling depends on the current cwd.

tests.name: normal hash escaped
tests.expected_behavior: contains %23 rather than treating #1 as a fragment
